description: This file contains implementation of quantized matrix multiplication operations optimized for Apple Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend in the PyTorch framework. It includes functions for converting weights to int4 pack format and performing various matrix multiplications with quantization, tailored for Metal API execution.

methods.name: _convert_weight_to_int4pack_mps
methods.description: Converts a 2D byte tensor representing weights into a packed int4 format suitable for Metal Performance Shaders, depending on innerKTiles parameter.

methods.name: _weight_int4pack_mm_mps
methods.description: Performs a quantized matrix multiplication between two tensors with int4 packing on MPS backend, supporting different qGroupSize options.

methods.name: _weight_int8pack_mm_mps
methods.description: Performs a quantized matrix multiplication between tensors with int8 packing on MPS backend, supporting different scales and quantization parameters.
